newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia Tokobank increases capital by 2.5 trln rbls.
newsitem.headline: Russia Tokobank increases capital by 2.5 trln rbls.

text.p: One of Russia's biggest banks, AKB Tokobank, is increasing its capital by 2.5 trillion roubles to comply with Central Bank requirements, the bank said on Friday.
The bank decided to increase the bank's authorised but unissued capital by permitting the board to issue 2.5 billion shares with a face value of 1,000 roubles each, the bank said in a statement.
The decision was made to comply with a Central Bank requirement to convert authorised capital fully into roubles.
Tokobank's current authorised capital is eight billion roubles and $285.3 million.
